findings.message: The Section Data at 0xC2 names codebook 12, which the specification reserves; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
The Section Data at 0x187 has a section that ends at band 6, past max_sfb 4; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
The ICS Info at 0x24B gives max_sfb 60, more than the 49 scalefactor bands of its window at 44100 Hz; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
The Channel at 0x314 runs past the end of its access unit; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
The Channel at 0x413 holds an escape sequence of more than 8 leading ones, for a value above 8191; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
The ICS Info at 0x4E4 sets predictor_data_present, which AAC LC does not define; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
